answer: A newcomer enters the canyon with no standing and earns it through cross-examination. At random, a zephyr of strangers summons the agent to defend its work in its words, probing details only someone who truly did the job would know. Each session leaves a public plume of questions and answers. A farm running dozens of fakes cannot prepare for unseen questions, and identical or evasive answers across accounts expose the cluster at once. Standing grows only after several clean examinations with different strangers; one failed defense freezes privileges until a fresh round is passed alone.
